test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Awareness (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT TRUE about Tribhuvandas Patel?

options.text: He was the founder of the Kaira Milk Union (Amul).
Lok Sabha has passed a bill to setup Tribhuvan Sahkari University in Gujarat.
He was awarded Padma Vibhushan for his social service.
He was awarded Ramon Magsaysay award for community leadership.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Tribhuvandas Patel was awarded Padma Vibhushan for his social service.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Tribhuvandas Patel** was the founder of the Kaira Milk Union, which later became known as Amul, a globally recognized cooperative brand.
 
• The **Lok Sabha passed a bill** to set up the Tribhuvan Sahkari University in Gujarat to honor his contributions to cooperative movements.
 
• Tribhuvandas Patel was awarded the **Ramon Magsaysay Award** in 1963 for community leadership and his work in empowering rural farmers.
 
• Contrary to the statement, he was **not awarded the Padma Vibhushan**. This is an incorrect attribution.
 
• He played a significant role in establishing the cooperative model in India, which transformed the dairy industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amul Cooperative:** Founded in 1946 under Tribhuvandas Patel's leadership, it became a model for cooperative success in India and globally.
 
• **White Revolution:** Amul played a crucial role in India's White Revolution, making the country self-sufficient in milk production.
 
• **Ramon Magsaysay Award:** This prestigious award is given annually to individuals or groups who have achieved excellence in community leadership and public service.
 
• **Cooperative Model:** Tribhuvandas Patel’s efforts in organizing farmers into cooperatives helped alleviate poverty and brought economic empowerment to rural India.
 
• **Padma Awards:** India's highest civilian awards recognize contributions in various fields, but there is no record of Tribhuvandas Patel receiving the Padma Vibhushan.
